items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Buck was writing nice... I would tell him to play these two numbers Buck did yesterday... Buck Linn, Ram because they had to score the harmony.

ctx.x: Because, like, if anybody brought arrangements around that was a little odd, he didn't want to play it. And the only way (inaudible) play it. And Buck was writing nice. And he wouldn't play Buck's arrangements. And a lot of time when he'd be getting ready to call the numbers, I would tell him to play these two numbers Buck did yesterday, and that's how they got playing. So Buck's numbers got played like that. And so I was the instigator.

But Basie's all right, but he always kept remembering what a hard time we had, and why should I work hard? I could hire somebody to write. And when I came back in the band, that's what he did. He said, now, Ed, you meet them in Albany, New York. I got the train and I went to Albany and I met the band.
